ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the vertices of $\triangle ABC$ are all on the grid points of the square grid paper. What is the value of $\sin C$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As the figure shows, connect AD.
According to the problem:
\[AC^{2}=1^{2}+7^{2}=50,\]
\[CD^{2}=1^{2}+2^{2}=5,\]
\[AD^{2}=6^{2}+3^{2}=45,\]
\[\therefore AD^{2}+CD^{2}=AC^{2},\]
\[\therefore \triangle ACD \text{ is a right-angled triangle},\]
\[\therefore \angle ADC=90^\circ,\]
In $Rt\triangle ACD$, $AD=3\sqrt{5}$, $AC=5\sqrt{2}$,
\[\therefore \sin C=\frac{AD}{AC}=\frac{3\sqrt{5}}{5\sqrt{2}}=\boxed{\frac{3\sqrt{10}}{10}}.\]

推理：按指定方法建立坐标系，取 A=(0,0)，横向向右为正，纵向向下为正，则 C=(7,1)，B=(5,5)。要求的是角 C 的正弦，即向量 CA 与 CB 的夹角正弦。
从 C 出发，CA=A−C=(0,0)−(7,1)=(-7,-1)，CB=B−C=(5,5)−(7,1)=(-2,4)。
使用二维向量夹角正弦公式：sin C=|CA_x·CB_y−CA_y·CB_x|/(|CA|·|CB|)。
代入得分子为 |(-7)·4−(-1)·(-2)|=|-28−2|=30。
|CA|=√((-7)^2+(-1)^2)=√50，|CB|=√((-2)^2+4^2)=√20。
所以 sin C=30/(√50·√20)=30/√1000=30/(10√10)=3/√10=3√10/10。

In $Rt\triangle ACD$, $AD=3\sqrt{5}$, $AC=5\sqrt{2}$,
\[\therefore \sin C=\frac{AD}{AC}=\frac{3\sqrt{5}}{5\sqrt{2}}=\boxed{\frac{3\sqrt{10}}{10}}.\]

ready3_open_rewrite.resolved_answer: \textbf{Solution:} As the figure shows, connect AD. According to the problem: \[AC^{2}=1^{2}+7^{2}=50,\] \[CD^{2}=1^{2}+2^{2}=5,\] \[AD^{2}=6^{2}+3^{2}=45,\] \[\therefore AD^{2}+CD^{2}=AC^{2},\] \[\therefore \triangle ACD \text{ is a right-angled triangle},\] \[\therefore \angle ADC=90^\circ,\] In $Rt\triangle ACD$, $AD=3\sqrt{5}$, $AC=5\sqrt{2}$, \[\therefore \sin C=\frac{AD}{AC}=\frac{3\sqrt{5}}{5\sqrt{2}}=\boxed{\frac{3\sqrt{10}}{10}}.\]

Side CB passes through a grid point D; this point is 1 square to the left and 2 squares downward relative to C, so D is on line CB; from the figure it can also be read that the offset from A to D is 6 squares horizontally and 3 squares vertically.

Reasoning: Introduce auxiliary point D and connect AD. By the grid distance formula, AC^2=7^2+1^2=50, CD^2=1^2+2^2=5, AD^2=6^2+3^2=45. Because AD^2+CD^2=45+5=50=AC^2, triangle ACD is a right triangle at D. Also because D is on CB, angle ACB is equal to angle ACD. Therefore sin C=sin∠ACD=AD/AC. From AD=√45=3√5 and AC=√50=5√2, we get sin C=(3√5)/(5√2)=3√10/10.
